latest_release.name: v4.3.3
latest_release.body:
> [!WARNING]
> We live in the era of big tech companies buying out OSS project maintainers left and right. Vuetify stays independent as long as community keeps the funds flowing to the OpenCollective. Our team is putting hundreds of hours in to keep the project going:
> - troubleshoot and fix top priority bugs as quickly as possible
> - review incoming PRs
> - deliver new features
> - maintain ecosystem tools
>
> If Vuetify is part of your stack, please consider [sponsoring the project](https://opencollective.com/vuetify) so we can continue delivering updates and fixes.
>
> Every contribution helps us keep Vuetify alive and signals to maintainers that their work matters.
>
> Thank you.

---

### :wrench: Bug Fixes

* **VDatePicker:** count range days correctly across DST in header ([#23358](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23358)) ([e5f8d5b](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/e5f8d5b70d909d311766bf1daa5884185a45fe7d))
* **date:** correct days/weeks diff across DST and time zones ([3d23fbd](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/3d23fbdd81ca88845b9f8137ccd12277911cd327))
* **locale:** correct Hebrew pagination labels ([#23371](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23371)) ([3fc7144](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/3fc71440ef45b1cfc8cb301ac4ad3be50a86f597))
* **nested:** apply value-comparator to opened ([#23351](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23351)) ([1fd02a2](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/1fd02a27a7bfc3b875a1cea9a3b0c0982a406a90))
* **useHotkey:** restart sequence on a key matching its first step ([ae76422](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/ae764227667a16a4baaf32afc0827b72bd65093a))
* **useHotkey:** holding a key should not advance a sequence ([f6bfbac](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/f6bfbacfc26609f3ddc4b454f3b154e4de44d7ed))
* **useHotkey:** ignore IME composition and modifier keydowns ([887388a](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/887388ab202d3e838990dfe111ad177eff549bc4))
* **VMessages:** drop the transition delay with reduced motion ([#23359](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23359)) ([d87d48d](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/d87d48d0a16628fdf69c804a37d00e09b01d92ce)), closes [#22165](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/22165)
* **VOverlay:** wait for root before running scroll strategy ([#23364](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23364)) ([6db4a1b](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/6db4a1b6619144cddc1f63a137dd70c3b95b4c01)), closes [#23363](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23363)
* **VOverlay:** resolve `target="parent"` when initially open ([21d1f7d](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/21d1f7df15174a36f9ce8abf18525782505a47a6)), closes [#19311](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/19311)
* **VSnackbar:** start timer bar from correct value and animate linearly ([24afd93](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/24afd93fb6d9017fc2220170a9f65cb012ba65e9))
* **VVirtualScroll:** keep measured item height when defaults change ([cb913a0](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/cb913a066c11198099b1a31c736e62b761e6f0df)), closes [#23366](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23366)
* **variant:** scope over/underlay styles to direct children ([#23285](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23285)) ([33635f9](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/33635f9656b31bfcf7aee7dba5cd95e2695bc0c9))
* prevent picking values in disabled fields and disabled/readonly forms ([#23375](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23375)) ([4360201](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/4360201d5cb9d856c7b79b8eff2e728331795008))
  * applies to: **VAutocomplete**, **VColorInput**, **VCombobox**, **VDateInput**, **VSelect**, **VTimeInput**


### :test_tube: Labs

* ✨ **VNavigationBtn:** add new component ([#23369](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23369)) ([e708423](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/
